<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
#encontrome-app{box-sizing:border-box}
#encontrome-app *{box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  
  --roxo: #4A15BD;        
  --roxo-deep: #401970;   
  --lilas: #C9B8F0;       
  --branco-lilas: #F7F4FB;
  --pessego: #F2A15E;     

  --roxo-700: #3a0f96;
  --ink: #2a1352;         
  --ink-soft: #6b5e8a;    
  --white: #ffffff;

  --grad-roxo: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a22d6 0%, #4A15BD 55%, #401970 100%);
  --grad-peach: linear-gradient(135deg, #f7b377 0%, #F2A15E 100%);

  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(64, 25, 112, .08);
  --shadow-md: 0 14px 40px rgba(64, 25, 112, .14);
  --shadow-lg: 0 30px 70px rgba(64, 25, 112, .22);

  --radius: 22px;
  --radius-lg: 32px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;

  --container: 1160px;
  --font-display: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Quicksand', sans-serif;
}
#encontrome-app *{ margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
#encontrome-app{ scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 90px; }
#encontrome-app{
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-weight: 500;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
#encontrome-app img{ max-width: 100%; display: block; }
#encontrome-app a{ color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
#encontrome-app ul{ list-style: none; }
#encontrome-app h1, #encontrome-app h2, #encontrome-app h3, #encontrome-app .brand-word, #encontrome-app .stat-num{
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -.5px;
  color: var(--roxo-deep);
}
#encontrome-app h1{ font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 3.6rem); }
#encontrome-app h2{ font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 3.6vw, 2.7rem); }
#encontrome-app h3{ font-size: 1.25rem; }
#encontrome-app .container{ width: min(100% - 40px, var(--container)); margin-inline: auto; }
#encontrome-app .btn{
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem;
  padding: .85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#encontrome-app .btn-sm{ padding: .55rem 1.1rem; font-size: .92rem; }
#encontrome-app .btn-primary{ background: var(--roxo); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(74,21,189,.32); }
#encontrome-app .btn-primary:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(74,21,189,.4); }
#encontrome-app .btn-peach{ background: var(--grad-peach); color: #4a2407; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(242,161,94,.4); }
#encontrome-app .btn-peach:hover{ transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(242,161,94,.5); }
#encontrome-app .btn-ghost{ background: transparent; color: var(--roxo); border-color: var(--lilas); }
#encontrome-app .btn-ghost:hover{ background: var(--branco-lilas); border-color: var(--roxo); transform: translateY(-2px); }
#encontrome-app .btn-on-deep{ color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); }
#encontrome-app .btn-on-deep:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-color: #fff; }
#encontrome-app .btn-link{ background: none; color: var(--roxo); padding: .4rem 0; }
#encontrome-app .btn-link:hover{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .brand{ display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .brand-symbol{ color: var(--roxo); display: inline-flex; }
#encontrome-app .brand-word{ font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--roxo-deep); letter-spacing: -1px; }
#encontrome-app .brand-word .dot{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .site-header{
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.82); backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.4);
  transition: box-shadow .3s ease;
}
#encontrome-app .site-header.scrolled{ box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
#encontrome-app .header-inner{ display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 74px; }
#encontrome-app .main-nav{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.6rem; }
#encontrome-app .main-nav a{ font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); font-size: .98rem; transition: color .2s; }
#encontrome-app .main-nav a:not(.btn):hover{ color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .nav-cta{ color: var(--white) !important; }
#encontrome-app .menu-toggle{ display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; }
#encontrome-app .menu-toggle span{ width: 26px; height: 3px; background: var(--roxo-deep); border-radius: 3px; transition: .3s; }
#encontrome-app .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1){ transform: translateY(8px) rotate(45deg); }
#encontrome-app .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2){ opacity: 0; }
#encontrome-app .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3){ transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-45deg); }
#encontrome-app .eyebrow{
  display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: lowercase; letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: .82rem;
  color: var(--roxo); background: var(--branco-lilas);
  padding: .35rem .9rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
#encontrome-app .eyebrow-light{ color: var(--lilas); background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
#encontrome-app .section{ padding: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6.5rem) 0; }
#encontrome-app .section-soft{ background: var(--branco-lilas); }
#encontrome-app .section-deep{ background: var(--grad-roxo); }
#encontrome-app .section-head{ max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto 3rem; text-align: center; }
#encontrome-app .section-head .section-lead{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 1.1rem; margin-top: .8rem; }
#encontrome-app .section-head-light h2{ color: var(--white); }
#encontrome-app .section-head-light .section-lead{ color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); }
#encontrome-app .hl{ color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .hl-peach{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .hero{ position: relative; background: var(--grad-roxo); color: var(--white); overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) 0 clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem); }
#encontrome-app .hero-blob{ position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(10px); opacity: .5; }
#encontrome-app .blob-1{ width: 420px; height: 420px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(201,184,240,.5), transparent 70%); top: -120px; right: -80px; }
#encontrome-app .blob-2{ width: 360px; height: 360px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(242,161,94,.35), transparent 70%); bottom: -140px; left: -100px; }
#encontrome-app .hero-inner{ position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; gap: 2.5rem; align-items: center; }
#encontrome-app .hero h1{ color: var(--white); margin: .4rem 0 1.2rem; }
#encontrome-app .hero h1 .hl{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .hero-sub{ font-size: 1.18rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); max-width: 540px; }
#encontrome-app .hero-actions{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin: 1.8rem 0; }
#encontrome-app .hero-actions .btn-ghost{ color: #fff; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); }
#encontrome-app .hero-actions .btn-ghost:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
#encontrome-app .hero-actions .btn-link{ color: var(--lilas); }
#encontrome-app .hero-actions .btn-link:hover{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .hero-quote{ font-style: italic; color: rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-left: 3px solid var(--pessego); padding-left: 1rem; max-width: 480px; font-size: 1.02rem; }
#encontrome-app .hero-art{ position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 320px; }
#encontrome-app .laco-card{
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 2.5rem 3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
#encontrome-app .laco-big{ color: #fff; animation: floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
#encontrome-app .laco-card span{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 500; color: var(--lilas); letter-spacing: 1px; }
#encontrome-app .float-pill{
  position: absolute; background: var(--white); color: var(--roxo-deep);
  font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; padding: .6rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); white-space: nowrap;
}
#encontrome-app .pill-a{ top: 6%; left: -4%; animation: floaty 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
#encontrome-app .pill-b{ bottom: 14%; right: -6%; animation: floaty 5.5s ease-in-out infinite .4s; }
#encontrome-app .pill-c{ bottom: -2%; left: 8%; animation: floaty 4.6s ease-in-out infinite .8s; }
@keyframes floaty{ 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-12px); } }
#encontrome-app .carousel{ overflow: hidden; padding: 1rem 0; -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 6%, #000 94%, transparent); mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 6%, #000 94%, transparent); }
#encontrome-app .carousel-track{ display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; width: max-content; animation: scroll-x 38s linear infinite; }
#encontrome-app .carousel:hover .carousel-track{ animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes scroll-x{ from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-card{
  width: 300px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.5); overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
}
#encontrome-app .vitrine-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-top{ height: 110px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 3rem; }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-body{ padding: 1.2rem 1.3rem 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-body h4{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; color: var(--roxo-deep); font-size: 1.12rem; }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-body .cat{ font-size: .78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--roxo); font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-body p{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .96rem; margin-top: .4rem; }
#encontrome-app .vitrine-tag{ display: inline-block; margin-top: .9rem; background: var(--branco-lilas); color: var(--roxo); font-weight: 600; font-size: .82rem; padding: .3rem .8rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); }
#encontrome-app .events-grid{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .event-card{ background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.5); display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
#encontrome-app .event-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
#encontrome-app .event-photo{ height: 130px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem; position: relative; }
#encontrome-app .event-emoji{ font-size: 2.6rem; }
#encontrome-app .event-date{ background: var(--white); border-radius: 16px; text-align: center; padding: .4rem .7rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); line-height: 1; }
#encontrome-app .event-date .d{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--roxo); display: block; }
#encontrome-app .event-date .m{ font-size: .72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .event-body{ padding: 1.1rem 1.3rem 1.4rem; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
#encontrome-app .event-body h3{ font-size: 1.15rem; }
#encontrome-app .event-meta{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .9rem; margin: .6rem 0 1.1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; }
#encontrome-app .event-meta span::before{ margin-right: .4rem; }
#encontrome-app .event-card .btn{ margin-top: auto; }
#encontrome-app .feed-wrap{ max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto; }
#encontrome-app .feed-compose{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.6); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: .5rem .6rem .5rem .5rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-compose input{ flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink); outline: none; }
#encontrome-app .avatar{ width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
#encontrome-app .avatar-you{ background: var(--grad-peach); font-size: 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-list{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.1rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-post{ background: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.5); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.3rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
#encontrome-app .feed-head{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-head .meta b{ font-family: var(--font-display); color: var(--roxo-deep); display: block; font-size: .98rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-head .meta small{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .82rem; }
#encontrome-app .feed-post p{ color: var(--ink); }
#encontrome-app .feed-actions{ display: flex; gap: 1.6rem; margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: .8rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.4); }
#encontrome-app .feed-actions button{ background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; font-size: .92rem; transition: color .2s, transform .15s; }
#encontrome-app .feed-actions button:hover{ color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .feed-actions button.liked{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .feed-actions button:active{ transform: scale(.92); }
#encontrome-app .opp-grid{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.6rem; }
#encontrome-app .opp-card{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 2rem; color: #fff; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
#encontrome-app .opp-card h3{ color: #fff; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
#encontrome-app .opp-card > p{ color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); }
#encontrome-app .opp-icon{ font-size: 2.4rem; margin-bottom: .6rem; }
#encontrome-app .escambo-demo{ display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: .6rem; margin: 1.3rem 0; }
#encontrome-app .escambo-side{ flex: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: .9rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
#encontrome-app .escambo-side span{ display: block; font-size: .72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
#encontrome-app .escambo-side.offer span{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .escambo-side.want span{ color: var(--lilas); }
#encontrome-app .escambo-swap{ display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .case{ background: rgba(0,0,0,.16); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; font-style: italic; color: rgba(255,255,255,.92); margin: 1.3rem 0; font-size: .98rem; }
#encontrome-app .case cite{ display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: .82rem; color: var(--lilas); margin-top: .5rem; }
#encontrome-app .check-list{ margin: 1.2rem 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; }
#encontrome-app .check-list li{ position: relative; padding-left: 1.8rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); }
#encontrome-app .check-list li::before{ content: "✔"; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--pessego); font-weight: 700; }
#encontrome-app .duo-demo{ display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; margin: 1.3rem 0; }
#encontrome-app .duo-chip{ background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); padding: .5rem .9rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .duo-link{ color: var(--lilas); font-size: .85rem; }
#encontrome-app .filters{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 2.2rem; }
#encontrome-app .filter-btn{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 500; background: var(--white); border: 1.5px solid var(--lilas); color: var(--roxo-deep); padding: .5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; }
#encontrome-app .filter-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .filter-btn.active{ background: var(--roxo); color: #fff; border-color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .dir-grid{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .dir-card{ background: var(--white); border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.5); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
#encontrome-app .dir-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
#encontrome-app .dir-top{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .9rem; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
#encontrome-app .dir-avatar{ width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
#encontrome-app .dir-top h3{ font-size: 1.1rem; }
#encontrome-app .dir-top .company{ font-size: .85rem; color: var(--roxo); font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .dir-cat{ display: inline-block; font-size: .74rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; background: var(--branco-lilas); color: var(--roxo); padding: .25rem .7rem; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .dir-card p{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .94rem; margin: .8rem 0; }
#encontrome-app .dir-benefit{ font-size: .9rem; color: var(--roxo-deep); background: rgba(242,161,94,.14); border-radius: 12px; padding: .5rem .7rem; font-weight: 600; }
#encontrome-app .dir-foot{ display: flex; gap: .6rem; align-items: center; margin-top: 1rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .85rem; }
#encontrome-app .dir-foot .city{ margin-left: auto; }
#encontrome-app .dir-social{ width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--branco-lilas); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: .2s; }
#encontrome-app .dir-social:hover{ background: var(--roxo); transform: scale(1.1); }
#encontrome-app .dir-perfil{ display: inline-block; margin-top: 1rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; color: var(--roxo); transition: color .2s; }
#encontrome-app .dir-perfil:hover{ color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .board-grid{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
#encontrome-app .board-title{ margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 1.3rem; }
#encontrome-app .board-col{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
#encontrome-app .board-card{ background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 1.2rem 1.3rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); border-left: 5px solid var(--lilas); }
#encontrome-app .board-card.seek{ border-left-color: var(--pessego); }
#encontrome-app .board-card.give{ border-left-color: var(--roxo); }
#encontrome-app .board-card.partner{ border-left-color: #7c4ad6; }
#encontrome-app .stats-grid{ display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 1.4rem; }
#encontrome-app .stat-card{ background: var(--branco-lilas); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 2rem 1.4rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(201,184,240,.5); }
#encontrome-app .stat-num{ font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--roxo); display: block; }
#encontrome-app .stat-label{ color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
#encontrome-app #connMap{ width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
#encontrome-app .map-node circle{ transition: r .3s ease; }
#encontrome-app .map-line{ stroke-dasharray: 6 8; animation: dash 1.2s linear infinite; }
@keyframes dash{ to { stroke-dashoffset: -28; } }
#encontrome-app .map-label{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 500; fill: #fff; font-size: 14px; }
#encontrome-app #connMap a.map-node{ cursor: pointer; }

          <a class="dir-social" href="#" aria-label="Instagram">📷</a>
          <a class="dir-social" href="#" aria-label="WhatsApp">💬</a>
          <span class="city">📍 ${p.cidade}</span>
        </div>
        <a class="dir-perfil" href="https://thiagovernetti2.github.io/encontrome/perfis/perfil.html?slug=${p.slug}">Ver perfil →</a>`);
      dirGrid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }
  categorias.forEach((c, i) => {
    const b = el('button', 'filter-btn' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : ''), c);
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      $$('.filter-btn', dirFilters).forEach(x => x.classList.remove('active'));
      b.classList.add('active');
      renderDir(c);
    });
    dirFilters.appendChild(b);
  });
  renderDir('Todas');

  /* =========================================================
     6. CONTADORES (impacto)
     ========================================================= */
  function animateCount(node) {
    const target = +node.dataset.target;
    const prefix = node.dataset.prefix || '';
    const suffix = node.dataset.suffix || '';
    const dur = 1600;
    const start = performance.now();
    function step(now) {
      const t = Math.min((now - start) / dur, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      node.textContent = prefix + Math.round(target * eased).toLocaleString('pt-BR') + suffix;
      if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  /* =========================================================
     7. MAPA DAS CONEXÕES (SVG)
     ========================================================= */
  const SVGNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const mapNodes = [
    { id: 'lara', x: 170, y: 120 },
    { id: 'cr', x: 460, y: 80 },
    { id: 'invictta', x: 730, y: 150 },
    { id: 'marina', x: 250, y: 340 },
    { id: 'bella', x: 560, y: 360 },
    { id: 'evento', x: 760, y: 330 }
  ];
  const XLINK = 'http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink';
  // pool de serviços/relações que circulam por tipo de conexão
  const flowPool = {
    buy: ['contratou', 'comprou de', 'fechou com', 'investiu em'],
    rec: ['indicou', 'recomendou', 'apresentou', 'conectou'],
    part: ['fez parceria', 'co-criou com', 'patrocinou', 'uniu-se a']
  };
  const COLORS = { buy: '#F2A15E', rec: '#C9B8F0', part: '#ffffff' };
  const mapLinks = [
    { from: 'lara', to: 'cr', type: 'buy', flow: 'contratou' },
    { from: 'cr', to: 'invictta', type: 'rec', flow: 'indicou' },
    { from: 'invictta', to: 'evento', type: 'part', flow: 'patrocinou' },
    { from: 'marina', to: 'lara', type: 'buy', flow: 'fotografou' },
    { from: 'bella', to: 'cr', type: 'buy', flow: 'contratou' },
    { from: 'marina', to: 'bella', type: 'part', flow: 'parceria' }
  ];
  const byId = id => mapNodes.find(n => n.id === id);

  function drawMap() {
    const svg = $('#connMap');
    if (!svg || svg.dataset.drawn) return;
    svg.dataset.drawn = '1';
    const mk = (tag, attrs) => {
      const n = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, tag);
      for (const k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
      return n;
    };
    // linhas + rótulos de fluxo
    mapLinks.forEach((lk, i) => {
      const a = byId(lk.from), b = byId(lk.to);
      const line = mk('line', { x1: a.x, y1: a.y, x2: b.x, y2: b.y, stroke: COLORS[lk.type], 'stroke-width': 2.5, 'stroke-linecap': 'round', class: 'map-line', opacity: 0 });
      line.style.transition = 'opacity .5s, stroke-width .4s ease';
      svg.appendChild(line);
      lk.lineEl = line;
      const mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2, my = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
      const lbl = mk('text', { x: mx, y: my - 6, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: 'map-flow', opacity: 0 });
      lbl.style.transition = 'opacity .45s ease';
      lbl.textContent = lk.flow;
      svg.appendChild(lbl);
      lk.flowEl = lbl;
      setTimeout(() => { line.setAttribute('opacity', .9); lbl.setAttribute('opacity', 1); }, 250 * i);
    });
    // nós — cada um é um link para a página interna (perfil ou lugar)
    const ents = window.MAP_ENTITIES || [];
    mapNodes.forEach((n, i) => { const e = ents[i % ents.length] || { nome: '—', href: '#' }; n.label = e.nome; n.href = e.href; });

    mapNodes.forEach((n, i) => {
      const a = mk('a', { class: 'map-node', opacity: 0 });
      a.setAttribute('href', n.href);
      a.setAttributeNS(XLINK, 'xlink:href', n.href);
      const halo = mk('circle', { cx: n.x, cy: n.y, r: 18, fill: 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)' });
      a.appendChild(mk('circle', { cx: n.x, cy: n.y, r: 9, fill: '#fff' }));
      a.appendChild(halo);
      const t = mk('text', { x: n.x, y: n.y + 36, 'text-anchor': 'middle', class: 'map-label' });
      t.style.transition = 'opacity .45s ease, fill .2s ease';
      t.textContent = n.label;
      a.appendChild(t);
      svg.appendChild(a);
      n.labelEl = t; n.haloEl = halo; n.linkEl = a;
      setTimeout(() => { a.style.transition = 'opacity .5s'; a.setAttribute('opacity', 1); }, 120 * i);
    });

    startMapCycle();
  }

  /* mantém o mapa "rodando": troca marcas e serviços em loop */
  function startMapCycle() {
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    const rand = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

    const cycleFlow = () => {
      const lk = rand(mapLinks);
      lk.flow = rand(flowPool[lk.type].filter(f => f !== lk.flow));
      lk.flowEl.setAttribute('opacity', 0);
      lk.lineEl.setAttribute('stroke-width', 4.5);
      setTimeout(() => {
        lk.flowEl.textContent = lk.flow;
        lk.flowEl.setAttribute('opacity', 1);
        lk.lineEl.setAttribute('stroke-width', 2.5);
      }, 450);
    };

    const ents = window.MAP_ENTITIES || [];
    const cycleNode = () => {
      const shown = mapNodes.map(n => n.href);
      const options = ents.filter(e => !shown.includes(e.href));
      if (!options.length) return;
      const node = rand(mapNodes);
      const e = rand(options);
      node.label = e.nome; node.href = e.href;
      node.labelEl.setAttribute('opacity', 0);
      node.haloEl.setAttribute('r', 28);
      setTimeout(() => {
        node.labelEl.textContent = node.label;
        node.linkEl.setAttribute('href', node.href);
        node.linkEl.setAttributeNS(XLINK, 'xlink:href', node.href);
        node.labelEl.setAttribute('opacity', 1);
        node.haloEl.setAttribute('r', 18);
      }, 450);
    };

    setInterval(cycleFlow, 2200);
    setInterval(cycleNode, 3400);
  }

  /* =========================================================
     8. REVEAL + observers (contadores e mapa)
     ========================================================= */
  const revealItems = $$('.section, .reveal, .stat-card, .event-card, .dir-card, .blog-card');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(en => {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        en.target.classList.add('in');
        obs.unobserve(en.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });
    $$('.reveal').forEach(x => io.observe(x));

    // contadores
    const statsObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(en => {
        if (!en.isIntersecting) return;
        $$('.stat-num', en.target).forEach(animateCount);
        obs.unobserve(en.target);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });
    const sg = $('#statsGrid'); if (sg) statsObs.observe(sg);

    // mapa
    const mapObs = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(en => { if (en.isIntersecting) { drawMap(); obs.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { threshold: 0.2 });
    const ms = $('#mapa'); if (ms) mapObs.observe(ms);
  } else {
    $$('.reveal').forEach(x => x.classList.add('in'));
    $$('.stat-num').forEach(animateCount);
    drawMap();
  }

  /* =========================================================
     9. FORM CTA
     ========================================================= */
  const form = $('#ctaForm');
  const note = $('#ctaNote');
  form.addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const nome = form.nome.value.trim();
    const email = form.email.value.trim();
    if (!nome || !/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) {
      note.textContent = 'Preencha seu nome e um e-mail válido 💜';
      return;
    }
    note.textContent = `Boas-vindas, ${nome.split(' ')[0]}! Em breve entraremos em contato. ✨`;
    form.reset();
  });
})();
